hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git push'; then STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 -L -A "Mozilla/5.0" https://seegoeat.com); BODY=$(curl -s --max-time 10 -L -A "Mozilla/5.0" https://seegoeat.com); if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ] && echo "$BODY" | grep -qi "SeeGoEat"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"✓ seegoeat.com is live (HTTP $STATUS)\""}" ; else echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"⚠ seegoeat.com check: HTTP $STATUS — verify the site manually\"}"}" ; fi; fi
